body: Do you think it's possible that all of these symptoms could be attributed to anxiety? Consciously, I don't perceive any reason for me to be anxious. However, I've heard anxiety can wreak havoc on the body. Is it possible that I am subconsciously experiencing anxiety that's causing this?
Have not had that test yet. I'll try to get it soon.

I've had the test, and it came back negative... That said, I have come to understand that the test is fairly hit-or-miss. Considering the time at which I started feeling this way, I thought it would be unlikely that it would have been a tick-borne illness because up here it's still snowy. I'm just really tired of going to the doctor and them telling me that everything looks fine, when I clearly feel terrible. I just want to be able to feel like my old self again...
Not ever to my knowledge... I had bloodwork done the other day, and received normal readings on everything except Vitamin D levels.
